Commentary.Commentary: Right then, the series is leveled now. England have bounced back comprehensively and destroyed the high-flying Pakistan side. Next they meet is on 3rd August for the 3rd Test match at Edgbaston at 1530 IST! Until then, Goodbye and Take care!

JOE ROOT, MAN OF THE MATCH - (On getting to 200) He says that it was special and the kind of support he got was good. He says that it was good to bat in out there by building good partnerships. (On his batting) He feels that it due to the practice before the series. (On the series) He feels both sides are playing very well and they are confident for the next game.

ALASTAIR COOK, ENGLAND CAPTAIN - He says that they dropped only one catch but overall they did really well to win it here. He feels Root was superb. (On their plan to play Yasir) He admits that they really worked hard to see him off. (On Root's batting) He feels that he is really playing well and is good for the side. (On the pitch) He states that the bounce did help them and the bowlers used the conditions to the extent. (On the follow-on not being enforced) He says that it was for the bowlers so that they could rest well and come in hard today and it paid off. (On Anderson and Stokes) He confirms that Anderson is doing fine but Stokes will undergo a scan tomorrow. He also says that the side still has good balance with depth in batting. Ends by thanking the crowd.

MISBAH-UL-HAQ, PAKISTAN CAPTAIN - He says that the game of cricket turns around that way. He feels that the toss was a crucial one as Root and Cook played really well. He opines that they played an all round good game. (On the toss) He says that they couldn't play well batting second and allowed the opposition to score more than 600 whereas it should have been 300. He also admits that their batting was poor in the first innings. (Talking about Yasir's bowling) He feels that there were less runs to bowl at, also the pitch didn't assist him. (On the form of their top order) He admits yes, it is necessary for them that they should really convert their starts into a big one. (On this series) He states that they will really look to turn things after these negative result in this kind of conditions as they are mentally strong. (On their bowling) He says that they are capable of notching 20 wickets.

Talking about the bowling, Anderson fared exceptionally by picking up a 3-fer. The real damage was done by Woakes and Ali at crucial junctures by sharing 6 wickets amongst themselves. Broad was wicketless and Stokes was taken off because of his calf injury. The home side has bounced back in style. Stay tuned for the presentation.

Woakes just before tea, took the game away from Pakistan by getting Misbah bowled. Since then, the hosts had to see off wild slogs, swings and solid defenses from Wahab, Yasir and Amir as they kept frustrating them with their batting quality and endurance. The show was finally brought to curtains when Woakes took Amir's wicket as they hanged their boots eventually.

Pakistan were asked to chase a gigantic target of 565 with almost 6 sessions to deal with. In response, England wasted no time and started picking up wickets from the word go. From being 7-1, the tumble went to 25-2. Hafeez and Misbah did show some resistance by seeing off the English bowling cautiously but Moeen Ali broke their zeal by notching Hafeez's wicket. Younis, the veteran played handy innings too after getting a second life but he also gave away his scalp to Ali and made Pakistan slip further.

England have leveled the series 1-1 and in the points tally it is 4 all. After scoring 589 in the first innings with a superb knock from Root, the home side went to bowl out the visiting side on 198. Surprisingly, the hosts batted yet again and added 173 with Root and Cook stitching a 105-run stand along with their individual 70-plus scores. We wondered why the follow-on was not enforced.

Length ball, wide outside off. Hafeez lets that through.
FOUR! Past the mid off fielder and runs! Full ball on off, Younis crunches it through mid off area for a rocking boundary. The veteran is getting going with his niche shots.
Tad short ball outside off, pushed to covers.

On the pads, flicked to the leg side for a brace.

Length ball outside off, Hafeez shoulders his arms.
Leg bye! Angling in delivery. Younis gets across and tucks it to the leg side for a run.
On the pads, Hafeez works it to the leg side for a single.
Serves it on off, left alone.
Bit short and moving away from the batsman, left alone.
Serves a length ball on off, Hafeez plays it with confidence and full face of the bat.

The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Length ball on off, angling in. Younis gets ahead and defends it to the off side.
Perfect ball on off, Khan strides ahead and fends it well to the off side.
That was an unusual defense. Full ball on off, Younis hops and blocks it to the ground.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
BEN STOKES will bowl from the other end.
Length ball on off, Hafeez off his back foot tries to work that to the leg side but gets hit on his pads.

Full ball on off, defended off the front foot towards covers.

The players are out on the middle, YOUNIS KHAN and MOHAMMAD HAFEEZ are back at the crease and CHRIS WOAKES will continue the bowling proceedings.
...Day 4, Session 2...

Pakistan have put up 47 runs in 16 overs at Lunch time and have lost Masood and Azhar. Hafeez continues to hold the line and expectation lies heavy on the shoulders of the jumpy Younis Khan. However, Younis suffered a close shave when he was dropped on 9 by Cook. For England, it's Anderson delivering the goods, taking both wickets but the other bowlers are doing a good job as well. Of course, this is all assuming the weather stays civil and allows cricket to continue as usual. Join us after Lunch and find out whether Pakistan can weather the English storm or if England can continue this one-sided contest.

England carried on their lightning attack with the new ball, putting up a substantial 75 in just 9 overs this morning. Cook and Root put up a selfless 105-run partnership, piling on the runs and declaring when both players were in their 70's. Pakistan's bowlers failed to deliver again. Amir stood miles apart from the others, claiming Hales, the only wicket of the innings. He also had an impressive economy rate, unlike the rest, who struggled with restricting the batsmen.
On length outside off, angling in. Younis plays it to the ground with the full face of the bat. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Woakes saves a a certain boundary! Fuller ball on the pads, Younis gets across and flicks it through fine leg. A good save and two runs are taken.
On the pads, Younis plays it to the leg side.
Length ball on off, Younis finally gets some bat on it. It is tamely pushed towards covers.

Length ball on off, angling away. A play and a miss by Younis.

The umpire raises his dreaded finger. Azhar asks his partner for a review but they decide against it. The Hawk Eye showed that the ball was going on to clip the leg stump. Anderson picks up his second wicket. England need 8 more wickets to win the match.
